description: De Nationale Geologiske Undersøgelser for Danmark og Grønland (GEUS): natural hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Datavejviser.dk, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by De Nationale Geologiske Undersøgelser for Danmark og Grønland (GEUS). Coverage: De Nationale Geologiske Undersøgelser for Danmark og Grønland (GEUS). The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about natural hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Støttedata med dybdeværdier for potentielle fareområder for oversvømme; Potentielle fareområder for oversvømmelser fra grundvand; Registrerede jordskælv i Grønland; Jordskælv registreret i Danmark. Formats seen: PDF, WMS, WFS, JSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datavejviser.
